question: What is the minimum internal temperature for poultry?
answer: Raw poultry, including whole or ground chicken, turkey, and duck, must be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) for at least 15 seconds.

citations.doc: FDA Food Code §3-401 — Cooking Temperatures — Poultry and stuffed foods
citations.heading: Poultry and stuffed foods
citations.snippet: Raw poultry, including whole or ground chicken, turkey, and duck, must be cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) for at least 15 seconds

passages.heading: Poultry and stuffed foods
passages.text:
Poultry and stuffed foods
Raw poultry, including whole or ground chicken, turkey, and duck, must be
cooked to a minimum internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) for at least
15 seconds. The same 165°F standard applies to stuffed foods, stuffing that
contains raw meat, and any dish combining raw poultry with other ingredients.

Ground or mechanically tenderized meats such as ground beef and ground pork

This also applies to flaked, minced, and injected meats.

passages.heading: Whole-muscle meats, seafood, and eggs
passages.text:
Whole-muscle meats, seafood, and eggs
 or mechanically tenderized meats such as ground beef and ground pork
must reach a minimum internal temperature of 155°F (68°C) for 17 seconds.
This also applies to flaked, minced, and injected meats.
Seafood, whole-muscle steaks and chops of beef or pork, and raw shell eggs
cooked for immediate service must reach 145°F (63°C) for 15 seconds. Whole
beef or pork roasts may use alternative time-temperature combinations, such
as 130°F (54°C) held for 112 minutes.

passages.doc: FDA Food Code §3-501 — Holding and Cooling
passages.heading: Hot holding
passages.text:
Hot holding
TCS foods held cold must be maintained at 41°F (5°C) or below. Examples
include cut leafy greens, cut tomatoes, cut melons, cooked rice, dairy, and
raw or cooked meats held for later service.
TCS foods held hot must be maintained at 135°F (57°C) or above. Food that
falls below 135°F for more than 4 hours must be discarded.
